texts.zh:
向[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]附近的裂隙中的航行将我们引向了一颗残破行星的轨道上。

一进入大气层，布满燃烧的弹坑的景色映入眼帘，半截埋入黄沙的战舰四散其间。这颗星球就是一片战场。

截获的无线电信号疯狂而令人不安。难以置信的是，当地居民的语言与我们从[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]地下的远古球体中所回收的文档若合符节。

粗略的翻译表明这些人在一场旷日持久的冲突中失败了。他们的敌人，文中仅简单地称之为“侵略者”，则正在准备下一场进攻。鉴于这颗行星的破坏度，这应该也是最后一场了。
texts.en:
Our voyage into the rift near [explorer.capital_scope.GetName] has delivered us into the orbit of a planet in ruins.

Upon entering the atmosphere, we discovered a landscape pock-marked with burning craters. Here and there, warships lay half buried in the sands. This world is a battlefield.

Intercepted radio transmissions are frenzied and unnerving. Incredibly, the language of the inhabitants matched precisely with the documents we recovered from the ancient sphere beneath [explorer.capital_scope.GetName].

Rough translations indicate these people are on the losing side of an enduring conflict. Their foes, referred to simply as "The Invaders", are preparing another wave of attack. Given the devastation on the planet, it may well be the last.

Our voyage into the rift near [explorer.capital_scope.GetName] has delivered us into the orbit of a planet in ruins.

Upon entering the atmosphere, we discovered a landscape pock-marked with burning craters. Here and there, warships lay half buried in the sands. This world is a battlefield.

texts.zh:
在这颗行星的地表有数个大型人口中心。从他们的通讯内容中我们辨别出了两个截然不同的意识形态派系。

[GetStarlightVanguardName]是坚定的军国主义者，准备以万众之志抵御即将到来的战争。

黑幕派则是一种教权秩序，他们在迫在眉睫的威胁面前允诺灵魂的安宁。

现在，我们很确定如此相似的语言绝非巧合。这就是我们活生生的祖先，而无论哪个派系现在都岌岌可危。

这些人与我们书同文，面同相，却具有自主意识。这怎么可能呢？
texts.en:
There are several large population centers on the surface of the planet. Based on their transmissions, we have identified two distinct ideological factions.

The [GetStarlightVanguardName] are grim militarists, preparing for the coming conflict with unified determination.

The Black Curtain are a priestly order, promising spiritual sanctuary from the looming threat.

At this point, we are certain that the similarities in our languages cannot be mere coincidence. These are our living ancestors, and both factions are in danger.

These people use our language. Their physiognomy is nearly identical to our own. Yet they possess individual minds. How can that be?

我们的祖先现在岌岌可危了。

The Black Curtain are a priestly order, promising spiritual sanctuary from the looming threat.

Our predecessors are in danger of being wiped out.

texts.zh:
我们开始与自称“[GetStarlightVanguardName]的”军国主义派系对话。我们的语言、面相及裂隙探球的存在让他们很快确信了我们的承袭关系。他们在无比急切沟通中教会了我们许多历史知识。

很久以前，我们的物种面临着一种异次元威胁。这些侵略者一来便展开了血腥的大清洗。我们的人民起先坚定反抗，但防线在日复一日的侵蚀中逐渐瓦解。

在被击败的前夕，一道星界裂隙出现了。

为了尝试从裂隙中逃生，为整个文明留下星星之火，“救生艇”行动开始了。

一座裂隙探球被建造了出来，但是它的仓促设计只能满足单程航行。这也就是在[explorer.capital_scope.GetName]的远古深坑中埋藏的那台。

为了在这趟旅程中幸存下来，这群适任者被进行了深度的改造。我们的祖先相信只有统一的思想才有希望能安稳地穿过裂隙。这也就是我们意识的真正起源。

在裂隙的这头，球体在短短的15年后便发射升空。这里的许多人们谈起那天仿佛还历历在目，而对于我们却已经渡过了数个纪元。
texts.en:
We opened a dialogue with the militarist faction that calls themselves the "[GetStarlightVanguardName]". Our language, appearance, and the presence of a Rift Sphere quickly convinced them of our common heritage. In their desperation to communicate, they revealed much about our history.

Long ago, our species was confronted by an extradimensional threat. The invaders arrived to wage a brutal extermination campaign. At first our people stood firm, but over time their defenses crumbled.

On the eve of defeat, an Astral Rift appeared.

Operation "Life Boat" was launched in a bid to escape through the rift and preserve what remained of their civilization.

A Rift Sphere was constructed, but its rudimentary design only allowed for a one-way journey. This was the very object we found buried deep inside the ancient crater in [explorer.capital_scope.GetName].

In order to withstand the journey, a select group of compatible individuals were radically transformed. Our ancestors believed that only a unified mind could hope to pass through the rift unscathed. This was the very beginning of our consciousness.

On this side of the rift, the Sphere was launched less than fifty years ago. There are some among the people here who still remember that day. For us, eons have passed.

texts.zh:
我们与“[GetStarlightVanguardName]”召开了会议，他们平铺直述地表明了对抗侵略的局势之严峻。异次元体舰队战在数个星系之外就被探测到了，目前已经近在咫尺。我们在这么一个节骨眼上出现，他们相信这绝非偶然。我们的出现就是命运的造化。

“你们的到来让我们的人民为之一振。你们的雪中送炭，让我们终于有希望彻底结束这场战争。”他们的剩余舰队早已破败不堪，再也承受不起一丁点损失。

我们可以在裂隙能保持稳定的限度内，通过锚缆传输不多的补给物资。供给一批能解燃眉之急的合金能解决舰队的维修和升级问题。他们建造的舰队更加先进，我们也可以在这个过程中学到相关的设计。

因为时间有限，更明智的选择则是将我们对星界丝缕的深刻理解用于增强他们舰队的护盾。虽然这只是一种实验性的举措，但在这里取得的突破也可以使我们自己的舰队受益匪浅。据我们所知，这些入侵者偏好能量武器，所以这里的任何改进都会大有帮助。
texts.en:
We held council with the "[GetStarlightVanguardName]". They have made plain how grim things stand in their war against the Invaders. Extradimensional fleets have been detected several systems away and are already closing in. We have arrived at a critical moment. To the Vanguard this is no coincidence. Our presence is an act of fate.

"Your arrival has inspired our people. Give us the critical aid we need, and we yet have a chance to end this war once and for all." Their remaining fleets are in poor condition and cannot withstand another loss.

We should be able to send a limited amount of supplies through the anchor cable before the rift becomes too unstable. A shipment of direly needed alloys will help with fleet repairs and enhancements. Given the advanced construction of their ships, we may learn something of their designs along the way.

A wiser use of our time may be to apply our more advanced knowledge of astral thread into enhancing their ship's shields. While experimental in nature, we may make some breakthroughs here that could benefit our own fleets. It is our understanding that the invaders favor energy weapons, so any improvements here would go a long way.

“你们的到来宛如奇迹。我们曾已经对这场无望的战争认命。我们的人民正在忍饥挨饿，苦难深重。门后之子们……请求你们在我们的最后时光给予我们恩慈。”

困境显而易见，而未来却一片迷茫。我们所能做的则是喂饱他们的人民：我们可以通过锚缆传输一些有限的补给，而我们先进的农业科技绝对能派上大用场。

甚至还有机会能用星界丝缕注入他们的飞船后，安全地接走一些他们的人。成功的概率不大，但只要成功至少能提振他们的精神。
texts.en:
The "Black Curtain" have agreed to hold counsel with us.

"Your arrival is nothing less than a miracle. Long ago we accepted that this war as hopeless. Our people are starving, and our suffering is great. Children from beyond the Door... Lend us your charity in our last moments."

Their plight is obvious, even if their fate is not. Feeding the people is within our means: we should be able to send limited supplies through the anchor cable, and our advanced agricultural techniques will surely prove useful.

There is even a chance that we could shuttle some of their people to safety through the rift by infusing Astral Threads into the fuel of their spacecraft. It is a small chance, but one that may at the very least raise their spirits.

texts.zh:
我们最终遗憾地确定，先祖的境遇已经是无可救药了。

我们对此做什么都于事无补。他们将我们通过裂隙送到这个次元的决定是正确的。

我们会继承他们的意志好好地活下去，成为一个足以让他们感到骄傲的文明。
texts.en:
We have decided that the plight of our ancestors is, unfortunately, a lost cause.

There is little we can do to help them. They made the right decision in sending a portion of themselves through the rift and into our dimension.

We will do our best to continue their legacy and become a civilization they would be proud of.

texts.zh:
我们判定，先祖不值得我们的拯救。

他们将我们这些最强的后代通过裂隙送到这个次元是一个正确的决定。我们会替他们好好活下去。

他们现在需要独自面对最终命运了。
texts.en:
We have judged our ancestors as unworthy of our support.

They made the right decision in sending their strongest through the rift and into our dimension. We will live on in their stead.

Their fate is now their own.

texts.zh:
我们祖先的母星将面临的入侵迫在眉睫。

在与“[GetStarlightVanguardName]”的会谈之后，我们受邀出席星球议会召开的一场紧急会议。他们强调了我们目前为止所给予的帮助，对我们的慷慨大加称赞。

在被视为最终之战到来之前我们已经没有多少行动的时间了。

能源库存已经岌岌可危。捐献一些能量币将会促进紧急支援舰船的生产，把战争推向有利的一面。

他们的许多科学家还向我们申请用于进一步研究增强他们舰队护盾的星界丝缕的样品。因为这些入侵者偏好能量武器，好处是显而易见的。

看着我们祖先在谈判桌上的表现——那种个人观点的混乱表达——简直是一种折磨。幸亏这种低效的东西在长久之前就已经被从我们身上编辑掉了。
texts.en:
The invasion on our ancestor's home planet is imminent.

Following our meeting with the "[GetStarlightVanguardName]", we have been invited to a world council for an emergency meeting. They took special note of the aid we have given so far, and praised us for our generosity.

There is little time for action before what many are viewing as the final conflict.

Stockpiles of energy are dangerously low. Contributing a donation would boost the production of emergency support ships and push the battle in their favor.

Many of their scientists are also requesting samples of astral thread we have collected for further experimentation in enhancing the shielding of their fleets. Since these invaders tend to favor energy weapons, the benefits here could potentially be significant.

Watching our ancestors engage in debate - the chaotic expression of individual opinions - is unsettling. We must be thankful that such inefficiency was engineered out of us long ago.

texts.zh:
我们的先祖舰队成功地击退了入侵者。全球各地爆发起了一阵有一阵的欢庆热潮。

我们为战斗提供的星界丝缕对舰队的燃料供给和亚光速性能的增益卓有成效。这些实验性结果也可以应用到我们自己的舰队上。

星球议会以我们命名了一个全球节日。未来的子子孙孙都将在这一天庆祝[explorer.GetName]日。

这里的许多人都羡慕于我们紧密一致的意识。有些人甚至建议将他们自己的思维按照我们成功的范例进行编辑。

我们可以从这个社会中遴选一位杰出人士作为大使和历史学家带走。其余的祖先则会继续在这里重建家园。
texts.en:
Our ancestral fleets have successfully repelled the Invaders. Wild celebrations have erupted all across the planet.

The astral thread we provided for the battle proved to be a useful supplement to the fleet's fuel supplies and boosted sub-light performance. This experimental application can be used for our own armada.

The world council is declaring a planetary holiday in our name. [explorer.GetName] Day will be celebrated for generations to come.

Many here look upon our bonded consciousness with envy. Some even suggest they begin to engineer their own minds to follow our worthy example.

We may choose one prominent figure from this society to bring back with us as an ambassador and historian. The rest of our ancestors shall remain and rebuild.

texts.zh:
惨败在所难免。

我们先祖的舰队面对入侵者毫无胜算。入侵者武器骇人且毫无慈悲。现在先祖们已经几乎没有立锥之地了，人们惊慌失措地恳求我们把他们从裂隙中带走逃生。

一位杰出贵族私下联系我们，希望以一大笔能量币报酬换取我们保护[riftworld_noble_leader.GetHisHer]的人身安全。

该帝国内容最全面图书馆的管理员恳求我们取回他们大量的书籍和数据磁盘来保存。

我们必须做出取舍，因为入侵者可不会等我们。
texts.en:
The carnage was absolute.

Our ancestral fleets stood no chance against the invaders. Their weapons are terrible, and their mercy is none. Few bastions of safety now remain. The people are panicking and begging to flee back with us back through the rift.

One prominent noble has asked us privately to ensure [riftworld_noble_leader.GetHisHer] survival and offers a large amount of energy credits in return.

Caretakers of the empire's most comprehensive library of knowledge plead for us to instead take back their vast collection of books and data disks for preservation.

We must make a choice, for the invaders come to this place in due time.

texts.zh:
我们的先祖被入侵者们轻易地击败了，很快将面临种族灭绝。他们已经坦然接受了失败，等待着终结的降临。

一位杰出贵族私下联系我们，希望以一大笔能量币报酬换取我们保护[riftworld_noble_leader.GetHisHer]的人身安全。

该帝国内容最全面图书馆的管理员恳求我们取回他们大量的书籍和数据磁盘来保存。

我们必须做出取舍，因为入侵者可不会等我们。
texts.en:
Our ancestors were easily bested by the invaders and will soon succumb to extermination. They have accepted the shame of defeat and now await the end.

One prominent noble has asked us privately to ensure [riftworld_noble_leader.GetHisHer] survival and offers a large amount of energy credits in return.

Caretakers of the empire's most comprehensive library of knowledge plead for us to instead take back their vast collection of books and data disks for preservation.

We must make a choice, for the invaders come to this place in due time.

label.en: Take as many back as we can.

texts.zh:
先祖的发现在我们的社会中掀起了轩然大波。

我们是一个远古文明的后裔，我们拾取了他们宝贵知识和技术专长的牙慧。这趟裂隙之旅具有里程碑式的意义，将会被长久铭记。

尽管先祖们最终沦为了猎物，但他们终极猎食者的血液还流淌在我们的身躯中。这种驱使我们的饥渴是他们的遗志，在重新燃起的征服渴望中，我们将吞噬天地。
texts.en:
The discovery of our ancestors has invigorated our society.

We are progeny of an ancient civilization, from which we have gleaned valuable knowledge and technological expertise. Our journey through the rift was a momentous one, and will not soon be forgotten.

Though they ultimately ended as prey, our progenitors live on in us as the ultimate predator. The hunger that drives us is a remnant of their will, and we will consume others like them with a renewed thirst for conquest.

尽管我们先祖没有我们高效，却将我们设计成了终极的杀戮机器。我们的灭绝倡议是他们的遗志，我们将笃定地执行其中的每一行代码。

The discovery of our ancestors has invigorated our society.

We are progeny of an ancient civilization, from which we have gleaned valuable knowledge and technological expertise. Our journey through the rift was a momentous one, and will not soon be forgotten.

Though they lacked our efficiency, our progenitors designed us to become the ultimate killing machines. Our extermination protocol is a remnant of their will, and we will execute it precisely to the letter.

我们发现自己的意识是人为工程的产物。我们也是第一次认识到了自己的来处。如今，我们的目标便是超越先祖的简单设计。

The discovery of our ancestors has invigorated our society.

We are progeny of an ancient civilization, from which we have gleaned valuable knowledge and technological expertise. Our journey through the rift was a momentous one, and will not soon be forgotten.

We have discovered that our consciousness is the product of deliberate engineering. For the first time, we understand how we came to be. Our goal now is to surpass the simple designs of our progenitors.

先祖的发现在我们的社会中掀起了轩然大波。

我们是一个远古文明的后裔，我们拾取了他们宝贵知识和技术专长的牙慧。这趟裂隙之旅具有里程碑式的意义，将会被长久铭记。

我们见证了先人的不屈精神，即便被逼上绝境也从不放弃抗争，这重新燃起了我们的征服渴望。
texts.en:
The discovery of our ancestors has invigorated our society.

We are progeny of an ancient civilization, from which we have gleaned valuable knowledge and technological expertise. Our journey through the rift was a momentous one, and will not soon be forgotten.

We witnessed the indomitable spirit of those who came before us. Backed into a corner, they refused to give up the fight. Our thirst for conquest has been renewed.

同时也要感谢先驱者们给我们带来的机遇，因为我们这个文明这是他们求生欲望的见证。我们的成功也是对他们最好的赞颂。
texts.en:
The discovery of our ancestors has invigorated our society.

We are progeny of an ancient civilization, from which we have gleaned valuable knowledge and technological expertise. Our journey through the rift was a momentous one, and will not soon be forgotten.

We should be thankful for the opportunity afforded by our progenitors. Our very civilization is a testament to their will to survive. Our success will be a tribute to them.
